title: Supply drinks only in approved, refund-marked containers
what: Supply drinks to retailers, or sell them for consumption, only in category A or B containers bearing the approved refund marking.

sources.title: Environment Protection Act 1993 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not— (a) supply a beverage in a container to a retailer for sale by the retailer; or (b) sell a beverage in a container for consumption, unless the container is a category A or category B container and bears the approved refund marking for containers of that class

sources.title: Environment Protection Act 1993 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.locator: s 3, words naming the body (found 18 Nov 2026)
sources.quote: Authority means the Environment Protection Authority established under Division 1 of Part 3;

triggers.note: Before first supplying drinks in eligible containers in the state

reach.condition: if it first supplies drinks in eligible containers in the state
reach.note: Drink makers and importers who first supply in the state; the register item also lists retailers and recyclers, which the scheme touches in other ways.

confidence_note: Quoted from the Open Australian Legal Corpus copy of the version shown (DECISIONS E-118); later changes not checked. South Australia's scheme approves containers (beverage container approvals, whose conditions bind under s 69D) rather than requiring a supply arrangement. Reach and framework marks follow the NSW requirement for this family; to check.

assessment.summary: Supply drinks to retailers, or sell them for consumption, only in category A or B containers bearing the approved refund marking.

marks.reason: Suppliers must register every container type and report and pay scheme costs.
Each state's scheme has its own registration and cost recovery, adding costs to selling in several states.
The deposit puts a price on littered and landfilled containers, a cost the market otherwise ignores.
